'''Graffam''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]], selling combat gear during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A light-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Graffam wore a beard and had a series of scars across the left side of his face. He wore red [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] over tan [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and wielded two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Graffam appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Centurion PvP Gear Vendor for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class, though removed from the game during an overhaul of the PvP gear system.<ref name="TOR" />
